title: Key Concept
text: Temperature is the only factor that changes the value of Kc. Pressure and concentration changes only shift equilibrium position.

title: Relate Shift to Kc
text: Equilibrium shifts left means [NH3] decreases and [N2], [H2] increase.

title: Calculate Effect on Kc
text: Kc = [NH3]^2/([N2][H2]^3). With smaller numerator and larger denominator, Kc decreases.
